question_text: A 23-year-old female presents to the emergency department with monocular blindness. She states that early this morning she lost her vision seemingly "out of nowhere." She denies trauma or any precipitating factors. She does state though that over the past year she has had occasional episodes of weakness and even an episode of urinary incontinence, which always resolve on their own. On exam, pain is elicited with eye movement and nystagmus is appreciated. The emergency physician performs a lumbar puncture. What is most likely to be observed in the CSF of this patient?
